errors.text_span: All six series are drawn as solid lines with no markers: the red line (ChemBART Small 20M) starts near the upper y-segment around ~0.8 at the earliest steps, drops steeply into the lower segment within the first several thousand steps, is near ~0.20 by roughly 20k, trends down to about ~0.10 by ~80k, and in the far-right segment (420k–440k) stays around ~0.04–0.05; the blue line (ChemBART Medium 20M) begins near ~0.8, declines rapidly to roughly ~0.20 by ~20k, is around ~0.09–0.10 by ~80k, and is around ~0.04 in the 420k–440k window; the green line (ChemBERTa Small 20M) starts near ~0.8, falls quickly below 0.4 early on, is around ~0.22–0.24 near ~20k, approaches ~0.11 by ~80k, and sits near ~0.05 around 420k–440k; the orange line (ChemBERTa Medium 20M) begins near ~0.8, decreases sharply early, is near ~0.20 around ~20k, reaches roughly ~0.08–0.09 by ~80k, and lies around ~0.04–0.05 over 420k–440k; the purple line (ChemLLaMA Small 20M) starts near ~0.8, drops quickly to about ~0.17–0.18 by ~20k, moves down to roughly ~0.07–0.08 by ~80k, and is around ~0.03–0.04 in the 420k–440k range; the brown line (ChemLLaMA Medium 20M) likewise starts near ~0.8, declines steeply to roughly ~0.15–0.16 by ~20k, reaches about ~0.06–0.07 by ~80k, and stays near ~0.03–0.04 between ~420k and ~440k, with small high-frequency fluctuations visible along all lines throughout the plotted steps.
